faqs.q: What is casual loading and how does it affect my pay?

bodyMarkdown:
## From Hourly to Annual: Understanding Your Pay in a 38-Hour Week

Whether you're negotiating a pay rise or comparing job offers, understanding how your hourly rate translates to annual pay is essential. The standard formula used in Australia is simple: **annual gross pay = hourly rate × hours per week × 52**. For a full-time employee working 38 hours per week, that's hourly rate × 38 × 52. This article walks through the numbers, from the National Minimum Wage to the **woolworths ceo salary, and explains where tax, super, and casual loading.

### The National Minimum Wage and Award Rates

From 1 July 2026, the National Minimum Wage is $26.44 per hour, or $1,004.90 per week for 38 hours. That works out to an annual gross of $52,237 (before tax and super). If you're a casual employee, you get a 25% loading, making the casual minimum rate $33.05 per hour. Many awards also have higher minimum rates. For example, the General Retail Industry Award sets different rates for retail workers.

### The Woolworths CEO Salary in Context

Search results for **woolworths ceo salary** show that CEO Amanda Bardwell received reported total compensation of about $4.22 million for FY2025, with a target total of $7.96 million. That's roughly 80 times the annual pay of a Woolworths store team member on Grade 1 ($26.07/hour, about $52,000/year) under the Woolworths Australian Food Group Agreement 2024. The contrast highlights how executive pay dwarfs award wages, even after the 4.75% award increase from 1 July 2026.

### How to Calculate Your Annual Pay

Start with your hourly rate. If you're on the National Minimum Wage, that's $26.44. Multiply by 38 hours per week: $26.44 × 38 = $1,004.72 per week. Then multiply by 52 weeks: $1,004.72 × 52 = $52,245.44 (close to the official $52,237 due to rounding). For a casual, use $33.05 × 38 × 52 = $65,306.80. The fortnightly pay is weekly × 2: for the minimum wage, that's $2,009.44 before tax.

### Super Is Paid on Top

Superannuation guarantee is 12% of your ordinary earnings (from 1 July 2026 rate) is paid on top of your gross pay, up to the maximum contribution base of $270,830. So if you earn $52,237 gross, your employer adds 12%: $6,268.40. Your total annual super is $58,505.40. The super guarantee is not deducted from your pay; it's extra.

### Tax and Medicare

Tax is deducted from your pay. For 2026-27, the resident tax scale: nil up to $18,200; 15% to $45,000; 30% to $135,000; 37% to $190,000; 45% above that. Medicare levy is 2% of taxable income (single, no surcharge). For $52,237, tax is about $7,071 plus Medicare $1,044.74, leaving about $44,121. For the Woolworths CEO salary of $4.22 million, tax is at the top marginal rate of 45% plus Medicare, though much is in equity and incentives.

### Using Our Timesheet

Our [timesheet](/) lets you enter your hourly rate and optionally add 25% casual loading. It calculates annual, weekly, fortnightly, and monthly pay, plus estimated tax and super. Remember: do not enter a rate that already including casual loading; use the checkbox to add it. The formula assumes no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, no allowances, no salary sacrifice.

### Award vs. Enterprise Agreements

Award rates are minimums. Enterprise agreements can trade away certain penalties for higher base rate. For example, Woolworths EA trades Saturday penalty for higher base rate above the General Retail Industry Award. The Woolworths EA Grade 1 rate $26.07/hour ( July 2024). The CEO salary is set by compensation committee, mostly at risk (73% variable).

### Summary

From the minimum wage to the **woolworths ceo salary**, the conversion is the same formula: hourly × hours × 52. Use our [minimum wage](/topics/minimum-wage) and [casual loading](/topics/casual-loading) guides for more detail. Always check your award or agreement for exact rates.
